T44.editorAutoFields: FM3-Edit set icon colours (effects blue, scene red) and Mini-Display Label (Long Name / Name); after STORE and reload the icons showed grey.

perPresetSwitchWords.region: definitions start 3052 bytes before body end; category word 2k, function word 48+2k, param word 144+12k (k = PP index 0..23)
perPresetSwitchWords.notStored: Icon colour and Mini-Display Label changed no body word; icons showed grey after reload.

findings.h5: Amp channel levels A/D -10.16 dB, C -7 dB survive STORE (display -10.2 / -7.0). User: lead could be ~2 dB louder still.
findings.h5b: Out 1 Scene Level 1..8 (-2/0/+1/-2/-2/0/+1/-2 dB) shows exactly in FM3-Edit before and after STORE: first device confirmation of OUTPUT_SCENE1..8.
findings.t43: Amp Level, Drive Drive, Delay Feedback, Reverb Time, Chorus Depth, Out 1 Level and Chorus Bypass modifier targets store byte-identically and drive the expected values; Chorus Bypass from Scene Controller 2 bypasses at 50% and 100%, engaged at 0%. CPU 49.7-49.8% vs estimate 50.4%.
findings.t44: Per-preset switch category 4 = Effect, 3 = Scene; Bypass and Select are function 0; Effect param is a block index (Drive 1 = 9, Delay 1 = 7, Reverb 1 = 51), Scene param = scene number.

limitations: Sound is a user listening judgement; no numerical audio measurement.
T43 modifier Source/Min/Max dialogs were not opened; bindings are inferred from displayed target values plus the byte-identical store.
H5 terminal answers were shifted by a pasted multi-line CPU table; the CPU values are recorded in display-confirmation.json.
T43 STORE readback was taken in a separate FM3_BIND_STORE.py --verify run after the first run stopped before readback.
T44 PP switches were not tried on a footswitch.
Screenshots are FM3-Edit display, not the front panel.
Block indices beyond Drive 1, Delay 1 and Reverb 1 are not measured.
